literal: Even penance to those who possess penance will succeed; that, those who lack that, undertaking [is in vain].
translation: Austerity is possible only for those who have already acquired the capacity for it; for those who lack it, undertaking it is in vain.
modern: தவம் செய்யும் ஆற்றல் உடையவர்களுக்கே தவம் கைகூடும்; அந்த ஆற்றல் இல்லாதவர்கள் தவத்தை மேற்கொள்வது வீணான முயற்சியாகும்.
explanation: This couplet explains that true penance or self-discipline (தவம்) is not an easy task that anyone can perform on a whim. It is only successful for those who already possess the spiritual strength and discipline (தவமுடையார்) required for it. For those who lack this inner preparation (அஃதிலார்), merely attempting to undertake it (மேற்கொள்வது) is a futile effort. The poet emphasizes that the very capacity to perform austerity is itself a hard-won quality.
